# Web Site

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:WebSite`](gmeow-WebSite.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/WebSite>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)

A web site — the published collection of web pages served under one identity (a domain, a project site, a personal homepage). A specialization of [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md); its pages belong to it via [`gmeow:pageOfSite`](../properties/gmeow-pageOfSite.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:WebSite`](gmeow-WebSite.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
